title: Laboratory protocol Smallpox Vaccination and HIV-1 in women
author: Kirstine Beck

steps_raw.instruction: Laboratory protocol Smallpox Vaccination and CCR5 expression
Place falcon-tubes in LAF-bench
Pipette 50 μl stain buffer and antibody (see overview on antibodies) to the falcon-tube
Pipette 70μl whole blood from the patient to the falcon-tube
Incubate for 30 minutes on a tilt-board placed in a dark box.
Add 1.25ml BD Lysing Solution (Must be room temperature)
Incubate for 20 minutes on a tilt-board placed in a dark box.
Centrifuge falcon-tube med blood and BD Lysing Solution at 300G in 5 minutes.
Extract the liquid from the Falcon-tube
Add 3ml PBS and resuspend.
Centrifuge at 300G in 5 minutes.
Extract liquid from the Falcon-Tube and leave 200 μl in the tube
Analyze on Flow Cytometer. 400 μl is read by flow cytometer.
Dilution factor must be considered when cell counting. According the manufacture of Transfix, the absolute number must be multiplied by 1.2.
Transfix-tubes must be stored in temperature between 2 and 8 degrees celcius.
Before analyzing of the results an antibody compensation must be performed.
use 1ml BD Lysing Solution per 50 μl whole blood.
Is mixed in ratio 1:10
1 ml BD Lysing Solution + 9ml sterile water
Must be mixed in chemical fume hood.
When adding BD Lysing Solution to whole blood the mixture must incubate for 20 minutes.
